headline: Man United weighing up Michael Carrick's future despite comebacks - sources
description: Man United's hierarchy are continuing to discuss Carrick's position with bosses keen to take their time before making a decision, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Xabi Alonso insists Chelsea were not 'bullied' by Sunderland after defeat
description: Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso does not believe his side were bullied during their 1-0 defeat to Sunderland on Sunday.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United to hire USMNT's Pochettino to replace Carrick?
description: Manchester United are in the relegation zone and could turn to United States head coach Mauricio Pochettino to replace Michael Carrick. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: 'The World Cup never really ended': U.S.-based betting sees rise in wagering on MLS, European soccer
description: Before the World Cup, many wondered if Americans would stick around afterward. Betting data says yes, they did.

headline: Man United shouldn't keep Carrick despite Villa comeback; how Barça beat Atletico
description: Man United came back to draw Aston Villa, but that shouldn't save Carrick's job. Plus, Barça escape Atletico with victory, and Man City's defensive woes continue.

headline: Man United's Patrick Dorgu 'not happy' despite scoring 96th-minute equaliser
description: Manchester United's Patrick Dorgu has said that he is "not happy" despite scoring a 96th-minute equaliser in the chaotic 4-4 draw with Aston Villa on Sunday.
